exposure: Metabolic acidemia (base deficit >12 mmol/L) vs. no metabolic acidemia (base deficit <8 mmol/L)
cohort: This study included 120 infants with an arterial cord blood base deficit of >12 mM/L and a matched control group of infants with a base deficit of <8 mM/L.
finding: Expert, algorithm-assisted fetal heart rate interpretation has the potential to improve standard clinical performance by facilitating significantly earlier recognition of some tracings that are associated with metabolic acidemia without increasing the rate of operative intervention, but this improvement is modest.
